name: GM CCA - Minneapolis Parts Distribution Center, Hudson WI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open corporate-campus PDC. 2024 Street View along Willis Miller Dr shows a deep landscaped lawn setback with no perimeter fence, no barrier arm and no checkpoint at the truck driveway. Trucks enter the south dock apron directly off the public road - no controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere along the road frontage or at the driveway in Street View. The only structure at the SE corner is the building's own office entry, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - there is no truck gate at all, so neither a manned booth nor a remote kiosk applies.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved dock aprons on both the south and north faces give ample inside-property staging room before backing into the docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building: a long continuous bank of dock doors runs the full SOUTH face (~40+ doors with dock-leveler shadows and trailers backed in, confirmed in Street View) and a second bank runs the full NORTH face (~30+ doors, trailers backed in on the north apron). Combined well over 50 -> 50+ band. Count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers are staged at the dock aprons rather than in a dedicated marked drop lot; ~18 trailers visible across both aprons -> 10-25 band. No separate fenced trailer-storage lot on the parcel.
fieldNotes.dropYard: False - no dedicated standalone trailer-storage yard; trailers sit on the active dock aprons.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks sit on two physically separate building faces (south apron and north apron), consistent with split shipping/receiving flows.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single truck driveway off Willis Miller Dr at the SW serves both inbound and outbound trucks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The driveway and dock apron are deep enough to stack 3+ trucks well inside the property before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide aprons and an open, ungated driveway leave abundant paved width to add an express/bypass lane or a self-check kiosk.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the parcel - the site is truck-served only. The nearest rail is unrelated.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town St. Croix Business Park in Hudson WI, bordered by I-94 and open land; small-town industrial setting -> Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~404,000 sq ft building (opened 2004) on a roughly 39-acre parcel, estimated from the traced perimeter ring.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single large distribution building with an attached office wing at the SE corner.

citations.claim: GM's own facilities locator page for the Hudson WI Parts Distribution Center (Minneapolis-market PDC), 2200 Willis Miller Dr; provides GM service parts.

verification.rationale: GM-operated CCA Parts Distribution Center (Minneapolis-market PDC sited in Hudson WI), confirmed by GM-domain facilities locator. No bankruptcy-era/RACER divestiture.
